summary: Clean — no regression since the clean round-1 audit. Re-verified the full current diff (6a89465..HEAD) across funnel.ts, FunnelStepForm.vue, FunnelStepsList.vue, uk/en locales, and the keyboard spec. Since round 1 only a code comment was clarified and three test cases were hardened — zero production-logic changes. Confirmed no XSS sink introduced: a grep of all added lines for v-html/innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacent/eval/new Function/setAttribute returns nothing (NO_DANGEROUS_SINKS_ADDED). All author-entered values (keyboard text, parse-mode select, per-button text) render via {{ }} interpolation or bind to native inputs via v-model — auto-escaped. The three remaining v-html tokens in the file are explanatory XSS-convention comments, not directives (lines 1012, 1210, 1574). The per-button keyword hint (keyboardButtonHint, lines 677-687) returns a boolean that only gates a v-if; the hint body emits the static i18n string funnels.steps.form.keyboardKeywordHint, never the raw button text — no reflected-XSS path. No hardcoded secrets/tokens/passwords in the locale or type files. Client-side validation (4096 hard cap, 1..10 rows, 1..4 buttons, 64-char button text, dedupe) is an intentional UX mirror of backend Decision 6; the backend 422 funnel_step_invalid remains the authoritative gate, and CLEAR_KEYBOARD still correctly omits SET-only fields to avoid backend symmetric rejection. OWASP A03 (Injection/XSS) — the only relevant surface for this client component — is covered with no issues. No injection, SSRF, auth, or data-integrity surface in scope. Status: approved.
